prompts.motion: Use the provided start image as the first frame and the provided end image as the final frame anchor. The scene softens as if being sculpted: the person's skin and clothes take on a soft plasticine texture with visible fingerprints, edges rounding into handmade clay shapes while the background turns into a miniature clay set. The person gives a small stop-motion style wave at the end, slightly jerky like animation at twelve frames per second. Audio: Squishy clay sounds and a cheerful plucked-string jingle.
prompts.endFrame: Restyle the entire image as a handmade stop-motion claymation scene: the person becomes a plasticine clay figure with visible fingerprints, soft rounded shapes and slightly lumpy textures; the background becomes a miniature handcrafted clay set. Same composition and colours.
